title: Fixing a wrong weigh-in for today asks 'Keep it?' against the wrong number
what: When today's weigh-in was saved wrong (say 765 kg) and the member types the right number on Add measures, the typo question compares the new number with the wrong one that is about to be replaced, and asks '76.5 kg — that's far below your last (765 kg). Keep it?'. The edit screen leaves the entry being edited out; Add measures does not.
expected: The weigh-in that the save will replace is left out of the comparison, as on the edit screen.
who: members who correct today's weigh-in on Add measures
how_often: each time a wrong weigh-in of the same day is fixed
fix_line: Leave the same day's weigh-in out of the comparison on Add measures

title: Body map says 'Nothing trained' when the 30 or 90 days could not be read
what: When the member picks 30 or 90 days and reading the sets fails, the map treats it as no sets and shows 'Nothing trained in the last 30 days', which tells a member who did train that they did not.
expected: A read failure says the sets could not be loaded, with a way to try again.
who: members who switch the body map to 30 or 90 days
fix_line: Show a could-not-load line instead of the empty state on a failed read

title: A treadmill box keeps showing a number it did not save
what: Typing a number over the top (incline or speed over 40, level over 100) leaves the number in the box, but the set is saved with nothing for that field, and no message says so. The member sees 45 while logging and nothing in History.
expected: The box says the number is too high, or holds the top value, so what the box shows is what is saved.
who: members logging treadmill, bike or rower details
how_often: only when a number over the top is typed
fix_line: Show a short too-high line under the box or refuse the extra digit
